name: life-guide
description: 把《生活手册》变成能照着做的卡片：结构化内容层 + 校验器 + PWA

scripts.dev: npm run content:build && npm run dev --workspace @life-guide/app
scripts.app:build: npm run content:build -- --optimize-media && npm run build --workspace @life-guide/app
scripts.desktop:start: npm run app:build && npm run start --workspace @life-guide/desktop
scripts.desktop:build: npm run app:build && npm run build --workspace @life-guide/desktop
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run app:build && npm run sync --workspace @life-guide/mobile
scripts.test:desktop: node --test desktop/lib/reminder-timing.test.mjs desktop/lib/window-state.test.mjs desktop/lib/menu-template.test.mjs desktop/lib/update-events.test.mjs desktop/lib/navigation.test.mjs desktop/lib/protocol-headers.test.mjs desktop/lib/dav-client.test.mjs
